note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. Seven pictures, chosen by eye from 14 trial pictures: the mirror and the light-from-the-clouds trials lost partly because Job 15 already has a man at his bathroom mirror and a man under a storm sky with his hand raised to the heavens. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God and the witness on high are not pictured, Job and his friends are shown through ordinary people of today, and nothing violent is shown: the tearing, striking and shooting of verses 9 to 14 are shown through a threat that has not struck yet and a target, never through wounds.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

sections.meaning: Long speeches that blame a suffering man only add to his misery; anyone could talk like that, but a true friend's words would strengthen him and ease his pain.
ideas: Three well-dressed visitors stand over a slumped, weary man on his sofa, all talking at him at once, one jabbing a finger, one holding flowers while lecturing
A worn-out man sits on his front steps while three friends stand over him talking at once, a gust blowing dry leaves round them
A man at a kitchen table covers his ears while three people lean across the table talking at him
A man in a hospital bed turns his face to the wall while visitors at the foot of the bed lecture him
A strong wind blows a whirl of dry leaves across an empty yard
A megaphone aimed at a man sitting with his head in his hands
A friend grips a struggling man's forearm and hauls him up onto his feet
A friend sits quietly beside a grieving man on a bench with an arm round him, saying nothing
A weathervane spinning wildly on a roof in a gale
A man shakes his head and points down at another man sitting on the ground

sections.meaning: His pain does not leave whether he speaks or keeps silent; he is worn out, wasted and alone, and he feels torn at, mocked and hemmed in by enemies on every side.
ideas: A man grown very thin stares at his hollow-cheeked reflection in a bathroom mirror, his old shirt hanging loose on him
An exhausted man sits on the edge of his bed late at night in an empty house, the dining chairs beyond him all empty
A belt with new holes punched far past the old worn one, lying on a chair
A man lies awake in the dark with his eyes open, too worn out to sleep
A lone sheep in a snowy clearing with a ring of grey wolves closing in from every side, teeth bared
A man stands alone in a city square while a jeering crowd presses round him, mouths open, fingers pointing
A man on a stage is laughed at by a whole audience
A small boat in a harbour surrounded on every side by towering dark ships
A man walks a narrow alley while faces at every window sneer down at him
A deer in a field ringed by hunting dogs held back on leashes

sections.meaning: He was living at ease when he was shattered, and now he feels set up as a target, hit again and again with no letup.
ideas: A single archery target in a quiet, flowering meadow, riddled with arrows from every side and torn open
A stone sea wall broken through in gap after gap, the waves pouring through onto a quiet garden
A china cup shattered on a sunny patio beside an empty deck chair
A calm lake whose mirror surface is broken by a thrown stone
A wooden fence post in a field stuck full of arrows
A dartboard with every dart crowded into the centre
A boxing bag hanging alone in a gym, split and leaking sand
A house window cracked in a spider web of breaks
A lone tree on a hill struck by lightning more than once, split down the middle
A sand castle broken by wave after wave

sections.meaning: He sits low in grief, his face red from weeping and the shadow of death on his eyes, yet his hands are clean of any violence and his prayer is pure.
ideas: Close portrait of a man in a coarse grey shirt, face red and swollen from weeping and dark shadows under his eyes, holding up two clean, empty open palms
A man in a rough burlap shirt sits in the dust of a bare yard, tears on his face, dust on his forehead, his empty hands open on his knees
A man kneels with his forehead on the dusty ground and his open hands beside his head
A man washes his hands at a basin, his face wet with tears
A tear-streaked face lit by a candle, eyes closed in prayer
Two clean open hands held out under falling rain
A man sits on a curb at night, his eyes red from crying
A man holds a sack-cloth shirt in his hands, looking down at it
A man's open hands, clean and empty, held up to the light
A man in a plain room prays alone with tears on his cheeks, a bare table before him

sections.meaning: Though his friends scoff and his days are running out, he cries that his cry must not be buried, for he has a witness in heaven who will plead his case as a man pleads for his friend.
ideas: A lone man on a bare hilltop at night under an immense starry sky, face and arms lifted, calling out
On a high ridge, a man with a tear-wet face looks up as storm clouds part and light streams down from high above
In a courtroom a man stands pleading earnestly for his worn-out friend, one hand on his friend's shoulder
A man in tears looks up at the sky while three friends behind him laugh and shake their heads
A man shouts into a wide canyon and his cry echoes off the walls
A long empty road winding away over the horizon at evening
A defence lawyer rises to speak, his hand on his client's shoulder
A friend stands between an accused man and a crowd, arms spread
A lighthouse beam reaching up into a dark sky
A letter held up to the sky by a man's hand

scenes.principle: "I have heard many things like these; you are comforters who bring misery, all of you. Is there an end to words of wind?"
scenes.shows: Three visitors stand over a drained, slumped man on his sofa, all lecturing him at once: one jabs a finger, one shakes his head, one holds a bunch of flowers while she scolds.
scenes.prompt: In a plain living room in soft afternoon light, a weary middle-aged man in a rumpled shirt sits slumped on the sofa with his head in one hand, eyes closed, drained and miserable. Three well-dressed visitors stand over him, all talking at him at once: one jabs a finger at him, one frowns and shakes his head, one holds a bunch of flowers while lecturing him. Their words are plainly crushing him rather than comforting him.

scenes.principle: "If I speak, my pain is not restrained; and if I cease, what of it goes from me? Surely now he has wearied me; you have devastated all my company."
scenes.shows: Late at night an exhausted man sits on the edge of his bed, too worn out to lie down, the house beyond the doorway dark with empty chairs round the table.
scenes.prompt: Late at night in a silent, empty house, an exhausted, thin man sits on the edge of his bed with his shoulders sagging and his hands hanging between his knees, too weary to lie down. Through the open doorway behind him the rest of the house is dark and empty: a dining table with empty chairs all round it. A single bedside lamp lights him.

scenes.principle: "He has ground his teeth at me; my foe sharpens his eyes against me... together they mass against me."
scenes.shows: A lone sheep stands in a snowy clearing while a ring of grey wolves closes in from every side, teeth bared; nothing has struck yet.
scenes.prompt: In a snowy clearing at the edge of a dark winter forest, one small lone sheep stands frozen in the middle. All round it a ring of grey wolves closes in from every side, heads low, eyes fixed on it, lips drawn back from their teeth. Nothing has happened yet: the sheep is simply surrounded with no way out. Cold, clear daylight.

scenes.principle: "I was at ease, and he broke me to pieces... he set me up as a target for himself. His archers surround me... he breaches me, breach upon breach."
scenes.shows: In a quiet, flowering meadow an archery target stands riddled with arrows from every side, its straw torn open, more arrows stuck in the ground round it.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet, peaceful green meadow full of wildflowers under a calm blue midday sky, a single round archery target stands on its wooden stand. It is riddled with arrows: dozens of arrows have struck it from every side, more arrows stand stuck in the ground round its foot, and its straw face is torn open. Nothing else is in the field.

scenes.principle: "My face is red from weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death, though there is no violence in my palms, and my prayer is pure."
scenes.shows: A man sitting on bare ground, his face red and swollen from weeping, holds up two empty, clean open palms.
scenes.prompt: Portrait of an ordinary middle-aged man in a coarse, rough grey shirt, sitting on bare ground. His face is red and swollen from weeping, his eyes wet, with deep dark shadows under them. He holds both hands up open in front of his chest, palms toward the viewer, completely empty and clean. His face and his raised open hands fill the upper part of the frame. Soft, even daylight.

scenes.principle: "Earth, do not cover my blood, and let there be no resting place for my cry. Even now, look, my witness is in the heavens, and the one who testifies for me is on high."
scenes.shows: At night a lone man on a bare hilltop lifts his arms to an immense sky full of stars, calling out.
scenes.prompt: At night a lone man stands on the bare top of a high hill under an immense, clear sky full of stars. He has lifted his face and both open arms toward the sky, calling out. He is small in the frame against the vast sky, seen from behind and a little to the side, the bright stars filling most of the picture.

scenes.principle: "That he would argue for a man with God, as a human being does for his friend."
scenes.shows: In a courtroom a man stands arguing his friend's case, one hand on the shoulder of his friend, who sits worn out with his head bowed.
scenes.prompt: In a plain modern courtroom, seen from the side, a man in an ordinary jacket stands at the table speaking earnestly toward the front of the room, one hand open as he argues his friend's case, his other hand resting firmly on the shoulder of his friend, who sits beside him worn out, head bowed and eyes wet. The front of the room is out of the frame.
